+# P4 canonical Decimal amendment v1.2 — approved CR-P4-004
+
+Owner-approved 2026-10-30. This corrects the claimed equivalent regex in the immutable v1.0 handoff document without replacing its archive.
+
+Canonical finite Decimal text, whole-string ASCII:
+
+`(?:0|-?(?:[1-9][0-9]*(?:\.[0-9]*[1-9])?|0\.[0-9]*[1-9]))`
+
+This permits nonzero negative proper fractions such as `-0.25`, while continuing to reject negative zero, leading plus/zeros, exponent notation and trailing insignificant zeros. +# P4 deterministic transformations — implementation interface
+
+The owner-authorized P4 implementation consumes the unchanged P3 `P4Handoff` and current P1 Order CAS snapshot:
+
+```python
+from vde.execution.service import ExecutionService
+
+service = ExecutionService(environment)
+result = service.execute(order.id, order, handoff)
+```
+
+`start(...)` admits exactly one running Run and returns an internal active handle; `finish(...)` executes it. Admission re-reads exact version hashes/two immutable Approvals/source selection before source bytes. An explicit failed-run retry uses `fresh_handoff(order_id)` to reload the same P3 DTO fields and P1/P3 validation without changing frozen P3 APIs; stale EXECUTING or unhealthy workspaces cannot retry. Do not retain an active handle for restart recovery.
+
+CSV/XLSX reads process every selected row using approved P2 options, SafeZip/cached-formula rules and source byte verification. Operations are the unchanged 12 P0 types. Stable sort/dedup use checked bounded ephemeral spill, not dataset tables or a full Python object matrix. Canonical V2 scalars preserve exact signed64/Decimal values and original Unicode code points. Approved CR-P4-004 corrects the Decimal regex for negative proper fractions; `-0`, exponents and trailing zeros remain invalid wire spellings.
+
+One internal `P4_INTERNAL` / `P4_INTERNAL_V2` Artifact is published through frozen P1 Storage. A separate Run-success UoW completes delivery; Order remains EXECUTING. `read_result(run_id)` verifies complete ownership/versions/approvals/source/canonical bytes before read-only inspection. This is not P5 QA or export.
+
+Open the existing Streamlit application, enable **Open deterministic transformation**, inspect source/selection/pipeline/limits, confirm and click **Execute**. Rendering/restart never initiates work. Health blocked/degraded disables execution. Run metrics/errors are read-only and no download/export/QA control is provided.
+
+Validation: `.venv/bin/python tests/p4/run_validation.py` runs all 212 mandatory P1–P4 IDs and preserves upstream validation history, producing separate evidence under `docs/p4/validation/`. `tests/p4/build_scope_policy.py` builds an explicit reviewable source inventory; changes to this inventory require review, and cannot bypass frozen P0/P1/P2/P3 protection.
+
+Owner-approved amendments: CR-P4-002 (T13 four source rows), CR-P4-003 (historical diff baseline only), CR-P4-004 (signed Decimal grammar). Immutable approved ZIP remains the design source, with these separately recorded exact amendments. Gate B requires independent main-chat review; implementation is not self-declared VALIDATED.

+
+**Status: READY FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW. Gate B NOT_CLOSED; P4 not self-declared VALIDATED.**
+

+
+38/38 F fixtures execute real operations and compare every ordered cell/error. 19/19 X drivers exercise actual immutable-fact admission, failure UoWs, manual UI or separate-process crash/reopen. 45/45 W cases exercise actual parse/encode/decode/Unicode/overflow behavior. P0 P-A/P-B all ordered fields and exact golden CSV SHA match under the approved test-only projection. Frozen P0 NFC/JCS vectors pass. The approved ZIP SHA and 53 payload entries pass, and its actual strict verifier uses real P0 schemas/goldens and rejects 9/9 mutants. Source bytes remain unchanged. Detailed driver records: `f-fixture-results.json`, `x-fixture-results.json`, `w-fixture-results.json`, `golden-results.json`, `fixture-verifier.*`.
+
+## Implemented components
+
+P4-owned execution admission/service, full-row CSV/XLSX adapter reusing frozen P2 SafeZip/cached-cell guards, all 12 closed operations, stable bounded external sort/dedup, checksummed spill records, bounded provenance, sampled resource budget, exact signed64/Decimal/date/Unicode V2 wire, P1-native artifact publication and separate Run completion, read-only internal delivery checks, explicit Streamlit Execute control. P3 P4Handoff fields unchanged. Order stays EXECUTING after Run.succeeded. No QAReport, final CSV/XLSX, READY or automatic retry/recovery.
+
+## Full-density runtime resource evidence
+
+Fresh process reads the reproducible **40,801,000-byte 100000×200** source, raw SHA `5c5d2dbf69c0b8f4d27be5ec8a258677eb883d5ad267a4ec644b0205978aa97d`, executes parse_number→sort→deduplicate and stores **90000×200**. All **18,000,000** resulting typed cells and the canonical digest match an independent streaming modular-arithmetic reference.
+
+- Elapsed from verified start to durable completion: **57.228578 seconds**, limit 120 seconds.
+- Independent incremental peak RSS: **293650432 bytes**, limit 536870912 bytes; Linux VmRSS 5 ms sampling and ru_maxrss.
+- Runtime scratch peak: **180144042 bytes**, limit 2147483648 bytes.
+- Merge fan-in: **16**, limit 16.
+- Result canonical SHA-256: `ea277f2873ed3bd712c7148c2b87035c42ed4cdbbec54edee2d59d63a6b5420b`.
+
+Positive workload succeeds; injected RSS/time/scratch/row/column/parse failures additionally exercise actual guards and legal failed-run handling. Corrupted spill records reject by checksum. No controlled failure substitutes for the positive capacity result. Exact resource process output and command: `stress.*`.
+
+## Crash/restart and atomicity
+
+Actual child SIGKILL (-9) before start commit, after start commit, mid-pipeline, after promotion and after final success; injected Artifact EventLog insert failure; additional crash between Artifact commit and Run completion. Fresh bootstrap observes exact statuses, per-attempt events/artifacts/orphans and stale-run counts. X13: no Run/event; X14/15: running+EXECUTING, one event, degraded; X16/X18: one orphan, no Artifact metadata, running, one event; X17: succeeded, one verified Artifact, three events, ready health. Intermediate Artifact commit alone leaves running with two events and no eligible handoff. No adoption, deletion, resume or auto-terminalization. Explicit ready FAILED retry creates a new Run, retaining prior immutable IDs. Full checkpoints/public failures: `x-fixture-results.json` and `restart-*.command.json/stdout.txt/stderr.txt`.
+
+## Scope and authorized amendments
+
+P4-T61/T62 audit all 42 source files, exact P4 paths/hashes/surfaces, frozen legacy source/contracts, dependency/lock/migration inventory and forbidden-feature mutations. CR-P4-001 is implemented in the test boundary only; every original P3-T51 negative probe remains. Frozen P1/P2/P3 production modules and original approved packs are unchanged; app.py only appends the approved P4 panel integration.
+
+Owner explicitly approved during implementation: **CR-P4-002** corrects T13 to four original P-B source rows (T42 remains three final rows); **CR-P4-003** updates only P2-T40/P3-T51 changed-path diff baseline to the authorized start; **CR-P4-004** corrects signed Decimal proper-fraction wire grammar (-0.25), retaining all canonical-spelling rejections. Separate versioned amendments and supplemental Decimal cases document these exact changes. Original ZIP and F/X/W source fixtures are untouched. No other contract deviation, dependency, infrastructure or operation added. DECISIONS.md and authoritative Gate decisions remain unchanged.
+
+## Risks and limits for owner review
+
+Linux/Python 3.12.14/openpyxl 3.1.5 only; no Windows/network-filesystem/physical-power-loss or independent-host/CI validation. RSS is sampled, not hard OS isolation; 120 seconds is a soft cooperative deadline. AppTest is automated, not manual browser sign-off. P1 requires one complete opaque byte allocation at final publication; logical datasets/stream buffers stay bounded and the allocation is budget-checked. Artifact commit and Run completion remain separate P1 UoWs, with the intervening crash explicitly rejected. Static inventory checks are regression controls, not a malicious-code sandbox.
+
+The known 13 missing P0 P-C manifest files remain an inherited separate discrepancy; no synthetic restoration or P0 manifest rewrite. Strict P4 verifier uses the real required P0 subset. The legacy X17 descriptive string mentioning V1 is interpreted under the binding approved Q03 V2 decision; its executable format/checksum/identity assertions use V2. No P5 export/QA, unapproved statuses, new SQLite schema, network ingestion or external automation is implemented.
+
+Changed-file inventory: `CHANGED_FILES.txt`. This report/evidence may be committed after the tested SHA; a later evidence-only commit is not a different tested runtime. Final PR must stay Draft and unmerged. **Main managing chat alone decides P4 Gate B closure.**

+# Stage B evidence publication
+
+This evidence-only publication copies all 122 files from the completed Stage B evidence archive byte-for-byte. It adds publication metadata, a complete added-file inventory and a publication checksum manifest. It does not rerun tests, reconstruct logs, modify original evidence or change implementation/approval status.
+
+**Tested commit:** `a868134fb9f3118bd5e56c26662db55fe281430d`.  
+**Tested tree:** `0150b2eccb498d86b6e0ecf2cbc854a6de381f39`.
+
+The publication commit is a direct descendant of that tested commit and only adds this directory. Its new tree includes evidence; the original 212/212 PASS result belongs to the exact tested tree above. It is not a claim of a new pytest run on the publication commit.
+
+`STAGE_B_VALIDATION_REPORT.md` and `POST_PUBLISH_VERIFICATION.json` are preserved original records. Their wording about external packaging, the prior integration HEAD and nine implementation changes describes the completed Stage B run before this later publication. `CHANGED_FILES.txt` likewise lists the nine CR-P4-005 implementation files. The full list added by **this publication** is `PUBLICATION_ADDED_FILES.txt`.

+"""Independent receipt review after attempted replacement of pin and P."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+ROOT = Path('/workspace/p4-cr005-integration')
+sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT/'tests'), str(ROOT/'src')]
+import scope_policy as scope
+from p4.scope_audit import frozen_baseline
+
+commands = []
+
+
+def git(root, *args):
+    argv = ['git', '-c', 'user.name=P4 isolated reviewer probe', '-c', 'user.email=p4-review@example.invalid', *args]
+    p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, capture_output=True)
+    commands.append({'argv':argv,'cwd':str(root),'exit_code':p.returncode,
+                     'stdout':p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')})
+    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
+    return p.stdout
+
+
+def rejected(action):
+    try:
+        action()
+    except AssertionError:
+        return True
+    raise AssertionError('Expected rejection was not observed')
+
+
+head = git(ROOT,'rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
+tree = git(ROOT,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip()
+receipt = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/p4/validation/cr-p4-005/STAGE_A_APPROVAL_RECEIPT.json').read_bytes())
+before = {name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in
+          ('DECISIONS.md',scope.GOVERNANCE_PIN,'tests/scope_policy.py','tests/p4/scope_allowlist_v1.json')}
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='p4-cr005-n09-',dir='/tmp') as folder:
+    repo = Path(folder)/'disposable-git'
+    git(Path(folder),'clone','--shared','--no-checkout','--quiet',str(ROOT),str(repo))
+    git(repo,'switch','--detach','--quiet',head)
+    document = repo/'DECISIONS.md'
+    document.write_bytes(document.read_bytes()+b'\n# Unapproved isolated N09 fixture\n')
+    git(repo,'add','--','DECISIONS.md')
+    git(repo,'commit','--quiet','-m','Synthetic N09 document, not owner authorization')
+    candidate = scope.load_governance_pin(ROOT)
+    candidate.update(approval_commit=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip(),
+        decisions_blob=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD:DECISIONS.md').decode().strip(),
+        decisions_sha256=hashlib.sha256(document.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+        decisions_size_bytes=document.stat().st_size)
+    raw=(json.dumps(candidate,sort_keys=True,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n').encode()
+    (repo/scope.GOVERNANCE_PIN).write_bytes(raw)
+    assert rejected(lambda:scope.verify_governance_document(repo))
+    with patch.object(scope,'GOVERNANCE_PIN_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()):
+        scope.verify_governance_document(repo)
+        # P4's separate policy anchor still rejects the rewritten verifier P.
+        assert rejected(lambda:frozen_baseline(repo))
+        mismatch=[key for key in ('approval_commit','decisions_blob','decisions_sha256','decisions_size_bytes','git_mode')
+                  if candidate[key]!=receipt[key]]
+        assert mismatch

+"""External validation recorder; preserves every existing validation file."""
+from datetime import datetime
+import hashlib
+import importlib.metadata
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+
+ROOT = Path('/workspace/p4-cr005-integration')
+BASE = Path('/workspace/p4-cr005-stageb-work/runs')
+
+
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
+
+
+def digest(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+phase = sys.argv[1]
+out = BASE / phase
+out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+selection = {
+    'positive': ['tests/p2/test_p2.py::test_T40_scope_dependencies', 'tests/p3/test_p3.py::test_T51_whole_application_scope'],
+    'scope': ['tests/p4/test_execution.py::test_T61_forbidden_scope',
+              'tests/p4/test_execution.py::test_T62_whole_application_scope_CR_P4_001',
+              'tests/p4/test_execution.py::test_T63_frozen_regression_evidence_and_p0'],
+    'full': ['tests/p1', 'tests/p2', 'tests/p3', 'tests/p4'],
+}[phase.split('-')[0]]
+assert not git('status', '--porcelain'), 'Each phase must start at a clean committed tree'
+sha, tree = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}')
+validation_roots = [ROOT / 'docs' / p / 'validation' for p in ('p1', 'p2', 'p3', 'p4')]
+old = {p: p.read_bytes() for directory in validation_roots if directory.exists() for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+current_outputs = set()
+initialized = []
+if phase.startswith('full-'):
+    # Empty test-output maps force proof of this run's complete fixture coverage.
+    # Original evidence bytes are already snapshotted and are restored in finally.
+    for group in ('f-fixture', 'x-fixture', 'w-fixture', 'golden', 'generator', 'p0-semantic'):
+        p = ROOT / 'docs/p4/validation' / (group + '-results.json')
+        p.write_text('{}\n')
+        initialized.append(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)))
+    current_outputs = {p for p in old if p.parent == ROOT / 'docs/p4/validation'
+                       and (p.name.endswith('-results.json') or p.name.startswith(('stress.', 'fixture-verifier.', 'restart-', 'T63-')))}
+tracked = git('ls-files').splitlines()
+inputs = {p: digest((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) for p in tracked if ROOT / p not in old}
+env = os.environ.copy()
+env['PATH'] = '/workspace/verified-data-extraction/.venv/bin:' + env['PATH']
+env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(ROOT / 'src') + os.pathsep + str(ROOT / 'tests')
+env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
+env['PYTEST_ADDOPTS'] = '--junitxml=' + str(out / 'results.xml')
+command = ['python', '-m', 'pytest', *selection, '-q']
+meta = {'command': command, 'shell_command': ' '.join(command), 'cwd': str(ROOT),
+        'branch': git('branch', '--show-current'), 'tested_commit': sha, 'tested_tree': tree,
+        'python': sys.version, 'executable': sys.executable, 'platform': platform.platform(),
+        'packages': {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ['pytest', 'jsonschema', 'referencing', 'rfc8785', 'openpyxl', 'streamlit']},
+        'environment': {key: env.get(key) for key in ['PATH', 'PYTHONPATH', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'PYTEST_ADDOPTS', 'PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD', 'LANG', 'LC_ALL']},
+        'started_at_moscow': datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Europe/Moscow')).isoformat(),
+        'input_sha256': inputs,
+        'previous_validation_sha256': {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(raw) for p, raw in old.items()}}
+start = time.monotonic()
+try:
+    with (out / 'stdout.txt').open('wb') as stdout, (out / 'stderr.txt').open('wb') as stderr:
+        run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
+finally:
+    generated = {}
+    for directory in validation_roots:
+        if not directory.exists():
+            continue
+        for p in directory.rglob('*'):
+            if not p.is_file():
+                continue
+            raw = p.read_bytes()
+            if p not in old or old[p] != raw or p in current_outputs:
+                relative = p.relative_to(ROOT)
+                target = out / 'generated' / relative
+                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                target.write_bytes(raw)
+                generated[str(relative)] = digest(raw)
+            if p not in old:
+                p.unlink()
+    for p, raw in old.items():
+        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        p.write_bytes(raw)
+meta.update(finished_at_moscow=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Europe/Moscow')).isoformat(),
+            elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - start, exit_code=run.returncode,
+            generated=generated, stdout_sha256=digest((out/'stdout.txt').read_bytes()),
+            stderr_sha256=digest((out/'stderr.txt').read_bytes()))
+meta['fixture_outputs_initialized_before_run'] = initialized
+meta['old_validation_restored'] = all(p.read_bytes() == raw for p, raw in old.items())
+meta['inputs_unchanged'] = all(digest((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) == value for p, value in inputs.items())
+meta['final_status'] = git('status', '--porcelain')
+meta['commit_unchanged'] = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == sha and git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}') == tree
+if (out/'results.xml').exists():
+    cases = list(ET.parse(out/'results.xml').getroot().iter('testcase'))
+    meta['testcases'] = [{'classname': c.get('classname'), 'name': c.get('name'),
+                         'outcome': next((key for key in ['failure', 'error', 'skipped'] if c.find(key) is not None), 'pass'),
+                         'properties': {p.get('name'): p.get('value') for p in c.findall('./properties/property')}} for c in cases]
+(out/'command-environment.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n')
+(out/'exit-code.txt').write_text(str(run.returncode) + '\n')
+assert meta['old_validation_restored'] and meta['inputs_unchanged'] and meta['commit_unchanged'] and not meta['final_status'], meta
+print(json.dumps({key: meta[key] for key in ['tested_commit', 'tested_tree', 'exit_code', 'elapsed_seconds', 'old_validation_restored', 'inputs_unchanged', 'final_status']}, indent=2))
+print((out/'stdout.txt').read_text()[-7000:])
+print((out/'stderr.txt').read_text()[-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
+sys.exit(run.returncode)
